name: origin
title: Origin
description: The next page opens out of the thing you clicked — a window the size, shape and colour of the link grows into the page. No dependencies.
docs:
Wrap your layout with the transition. This is the only step:

  // app/layout.tsx
  import { OriginTransition } from "@/components/origin"

  export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
    return (
      <html lang="en">
        <body>
          <OriginTransition>{children}</OriginTransition>
        </body>
      </html>
    )
  }

Your existing <Link>s and <a>s are intercepted automatically. New tabs,
modified clicks, downloads, external links and same-page hashes are left alone.

The next page opens out of the thing you clicked. A window the size, shape
and colour of the link grows to fill the screen while the page inside it
grows to full size; its sides bow outward as it grows and flatten as they
meet the edges. The rectangle, corner radius and colour are read from the
link at click time — a transparent link takes the nearest painted surface
behind it — so nothing is configured and a theme change costs nothing.

duration is seconds for the whole opening (0.8), dim how far the outgoing
page darkens (0.25), bulge how far the sides bow as a fraction of their
length (0.12; 0 keeps them straight), minScale the smallest the incoming page
is drawn at the start (0.35). fill forces one colour for every opening;
data-origin-fill on a single link overrides just that one.

Needs the View Transitions API: Chrome 111+, Safari 18+, Firefox 132+. Older
browsers navigate normally with no animation. Browser back/forward is not
animated.
